[SBB Mobile IOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sbb-mobile/id294855237) | [SBB Mobile Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ch.sbb.mobile.android.b2c&feature=search_result&hl=en)

**SBB Preview** - [always be among the first to test the latest features.](https://www.sbb.ch/en/travel-information/apps/sbb-preview.html)

[*.sbbmobile.ch]()

[FAQ for SBB Mobile and SBB Preview](https://www.sbb.ch/en/help-and-contact/products-services/apps/sbb-mobile-sbb-preview/sbb-mobile-app.html)

in_scope.instructions:
[Swisspass](https://www.swisspass.ch/home?lang=en) is the key to mobility in Switzerland.

With SwissPass customers can manage their travelcard details easily and use the partner services.

Please note that the following URL scheme is excluded from the program: `https://mailing.swisspass.ch/r/wxmc/swisspass/{20-chars}/{20-chars}/{13-chars}/{26-chars}`

in_scope.instructions:
**SBB Freesurf** - browse the web for free on the train.
[SBB Freesurf IOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sbb-freesurf/id1437409619) |  [SBB Freesurf Android](https://play.google.com/store/search?q=freesurf&c=apps&hl=en)

**SBB GO** - as a study paricipant, you can record your customer journey with the SBB go app and evaluate SBB Touchpoints along your journey.
[SBB GO IOS](https://apps.apple.com/ch/app/sbb-go/id1224135762) | [SBB GO Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ch.sbb.kd.kom.sbbgo)

**SBB Inclusive** - provides visual and digital customer information in stations and on SBB long-distance services
[SBB Inclusive IOS](https://apps.apple.com/ch/app/sbb-inclusive/id1495023290) | [SBB Inclusive Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ch.sbb.inclusive&hl=en)

**SBB P-Rail**  - [your parking space at the station](https://www.sbb.ch/en/tickets-offers/private-transport/car-parking/park-and-rail.html)
[P+Rail IOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/p-rail/id1355008152) | [P+Rail Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ch.sbb.prail2&hl=en_US&gl=US&pli=1=)
